newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Best Buy downgraded.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Best Buy downgraded.

text.p: -- EVEREN Securities Inc said Thursday it downgraded the investment rating on Best Buy Inc to underperform intermediate term and market performer long term from market performer intermediate term and outperform long term.

-- It also lowered its EPS estimates on the company, to a loss of $0.18 for the FY97 fourth quarter from a previous estimated profit of $0.32. For full-year FY97, it sees a loss of $0.18 per share instead of profit of $0.45 and for FY98, it expects profit of $0.20 instead of $0.70 per share.
-- EVEREN noted that the retailer, which posted a Q3 loss of $0.25 per share, is currently not in compliance on its interest coverage ratio covenant with its bank.

-- "Although management anticipates a waiver with its bank to resolve its non-compliance, we believe other problems could arise over the next six months as a result of both industry and company conditions," analyst Beth Richard said in a report.
-- Best Buy was trading at 11-01/4, off 5/8.
